text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 2: IFS forecasts a day and a week ahead, against CAMS, on three days'
text.tspan: Figure 2: IFS forecasts a day and a week ahead, against CAMS, on three

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'One NGED solar farm, daylight hours, March 2024 to April 2026. IFS: ECMWF's forecast via Open-Meteo. CAMS: satellite irradiance service. Three days at one farm, chosen by the CAMS clear-sky index of its daylight hours: the clearest (highest mean), the most variable (highest spread), and the dullest (lowest mean). The same hours are drawn at both lead days. Hours before 06 and after 18 UTC are not drawn. Clear-sky index: CAMS irradiance divided by CAMS's irradiance for a cloudless sky. Lead day L: the forecast was issued L days before the day it describes, so lead day 1 is the morning before.'
text.tspan: One NGED solar farm, daylight hours, March 2024 to April 2026. IFS: ECMWF's forecast via Open-Meteo. CAMS:
Three days at one farm, chosen by the CAMS clear-sky index of its daylight hours: the clearest (highest mean), the
most variable (highest spread), and the dullest (lowest mean). The same hours are drawn at both lead days.
Hours before 06 and after 18 UTC are not drawn.
Clear-sky index: CAMS irradiance divided by CAMS's irradiance for a cloudless sky.
Lead day L: the forecast was issued L days before the day it describes, so lead day 1 is the morning before.
